annotations.title: Undo the last change made through the assistant

description: Restores a project to the state before the last change made with vedutum_furnish_rooms, vedutum_set_design, vedutum_add_solar or vedutum_set_site_address. One step; changes made in the app are not touched.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

project_id.description: Project id, as vedutum_list_projects returns it
